identity.text: Please submit further clicks in triplicate.
Hit rock. Keep bits. Even you understand.
You said hands on deck. I ripped the door off.
My lunch break has filed a grievance.
This hammer is not a doorbell.
The shield does not answer faster when tapped.
I was promised a standing desk. This is just standing.
Repeated inspections will not polish this armor.
A new archer joins the watch.
That position is out of reach.
My range does not include the complaints department.
Three forms for one arrow. Procurement is winning.
The bow was quieter before this meeting.
Spit it out. My back is busy.
Tools ready. Your brains? Doubt it.
Shut your mouth. I have bones to break.
You picked the wrong worksite, scum.
Chop first. Your whining comes free.
More hauling? You lazy little runt.
Strong back. Rotten mood. Give me work.
Got tools. Got fists. Pick one.
No path, idiot. Want me to eat the wall?
Poke me again. Lose the poking finger.
Break a leg? Your leg or the chair leg?
Move your arse. The axe goes first.
Come here, you spineless little rat!
Touch our supplies. Lose your hands.
This pile is ours. Crawl away.
Give me a fight, not a speech.
Your enemies have too many teeth.
Too far, genius. I brought an axe.
Hold the line? I strangled the rope.
You said flank. I ate it. Tough cow.
Stop clicking. My axe is getting ideas.
What now? My arrows are bored.
Speak up, runt. Then shut up.
Fine. Keep your head below my elbow.
Moving. Stop breathing down my neck.
Out of the way. I hunt ugly things.
Put an arrow in that mouth!
Pin the coward to the dirt!
Nobody steals our loot. Except us.
Touch the tools. Meet the pointy end.
Dig faster. I hate guard duty.
Hunter here. Give me something annoying.
No shot, idiot. Move your big head.
Draw the bow? I drew a pig. Looks like you.
String along? I tied the scout to a tree.
Keep poking. I am running out of warning arrows.
The grove is in capable hands.
Mind the roots as we pass.
I shall tend to the harvest.
That path is beneath even us.
Even an oak responds to fewer knocks.
Centuries of practice, and now this management.
I shall watch over the tenders.
I could have composed a sonnet between those clicks.
Repeated instructions rarely improve their quality.
Yes, this is my attentive expression.
I shall take the high view.
An arrow cannot reach every wish.
My eyebrows have acknowledged the order.
An arrow flies straighter than this conversation.
Patience is a virtue. You may borrow some.
This beard is not a bell rope.
That many taps should have struck ore by now.
The shield is tested. Stop testing me.
The workers can dig in peace.
The bolt has less patience than I do.
Do not rush craftsmanship. Especially loaded craftsmanship.
Clicking is not an approved winding mechanism.
That button has a warranty limit.
Every click is another unpaid consultation.
Moving before the rent is due.
No safe route. Or unsafe route.
You broke it, you bought the consultant.
I am not the launch button.
Repeated clicks do not include express shipping.
Customer feedback should travel away from me.
The sling has fewer moving parts than your instructions.
Yes? The dirt has filed a complaint.
I dug a moat. Accounting called it a hole.
The axe is management. I handle the branches.
On my way. Overtime starts at dusk.
Present. The helmet counts as formal wear.
My battle plan has a very brave appendix.
I practiced my heroic pose. It chafes.
Moving out. Keep the parade short.
My aim is better than my small talk.
Reporting. Please stand behind the bow.
The arrows are numbered. Returning them is optional.
I requested a raise. They raised the target.
Taking position. Mind the sharp luggage.
Moving. The quiver gets a window seat.
Boss say dig deep. Me found more dirt.
Me build house. Roof keep falling upward wrong.
Me count victories on fingers. Need more fingers.
Me tried whispering. Broke a window.
Me go there. There look breakable.
Me shoot warning arrow. Arrow not good at warning.
Me aim with both eyes. Twice as suspicious.
Me take spot. Spot better be good.
Yes? I was improving the soil.
I composted the criticism. It finally became useful.
I shall make that location presentable.
I trust this is an aesthetically sound assignment.
My armor reflects light and poor judgment.
I rehearsed victory. Your applause was late.
A measured advance. Try to keep up.
A keen eye. Two, in fact.
I see the point. Usually before you do.
My arrows have better manners than your guests.
I missed once. The target apologized.
Aye. Make it worth the blisters.
My beard caught sawdust. Free insulation.
On the move. Keep the kettle warm.
Aye. Shield weighs less than your instructions.
My armor has dents older than your commander.
Retreat? These boots came without reverse.
I measure twice and shoot once. Usually.
The beard is a wind gauge. Precision equipment.
That smoke is a progress indicator.
On my way. Keep the receipt.
My armor is rented. Please aim elsewhere.
Heroism available in three payment plans.
New position! Same low survival estimate.
Precision costs extra. Enthusiasm is included.
Exploding arrows? That is the premium subscription.
